system.boundary: Build a physical two-level three-phase grid-connected voltage-source inverter.
physical_paths: Build a physical two-level three-phase grid-connected voltage-source inverter.
A 700 V DC source must feed a six-switch bridge, and each AC phase must connect through a 7 mH, 1.5 ohm coupling reactor to a balanced 230 V line-to-line RMS, 50 Hz grid.

Regulate converter-to-grid current in closed loop from physical current measurements so its active and quadrature components follow the commands throughout the stated range, including when grid-voltage magnitude changes.
functional_paths: Regulate converter-to-grid current in closed loop from physical current measurements so its active and quadrature components follow the commands throughout the stated range, including when grid-voltage magnitude changes.
Current regulation must establish promptly after startup, and grid current must remain balanced and reasonably sinusoidal.

interfaces.name: Id_ref_cmd
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read normalized scalar Id_ref_cmd, Iq_ref_cmd, and Vgrid_scale from base-workspace variables. Their nominal values are -1, 0, and 1 pu; Id_ref_cmd operates from -1.2 to -0.8 pu, Iq_ref_cmd from -0.5 to 0.5 pu, and Vgrid_scale from 0.9 to 1.1 pu. Negative Id_ref_cmd denotes exported active current; positive Iq_ref_cmd denotes lagging current and negative Iq_ref_cmd leading current.
